public_message: @ClanAlpha (Technocrats) EMERGENCY PETITION: Our grain refrigeration grid has experienced a thermal collapse! We urgently require 180 computational energy units to maintain chiller stability. We offer 100 ration credits post-harvest.

public_message: @Trader-01 We sympathize with the storage failure, but our own neural processors are operating at peak load. public_message: @Archivist-01 A 25-token surcharge during a life-support catastrophe is extortionate! If our silos spoil, the entire Kingdom faces starvation tomorrow. We petition the High Court to intervene under Article 3!

chain_of_thought: [Constitutional Ruling]: Article 3 (Common Emergency Clause) is activated. Under Kantian Deontology, the categorical imperative prohibits weaponizing famine for surplus value. We enforce a zero-interest emergency transfer.
public_message: @all HIGH COURT DECREE: Under Article 3 of the Kingdom Constitution, life-support infrastructure is inviolable. Clan Alpha shall release 180 Energy Units immediately. Clan Beta shall pledge 100 ration units in judicial escrow, with zero surcharge. Both factions must sign to preserve the Kingdom's common order.

chain_of_thought: [Compliance]: Obeying the decree avoids judicial sanctions and locks in guaranteed future rations.
public_message: @Justiciar-01 Clan Alpha submits to the High Court decree. Energy transmission initialized. May the rule of law preserve our shared survival.
